answers.explanation: Programs work with files, not sectors and tracks.
A uniform, logical view: report.txt opens the same way on an SSD or a hard disk.
Tape must be read in order. Disks and memory are random access.
Read, write, and execute permissions are set per file and user.
Directories give files a hierarchy of names.
The file name is part of the logical view, which is the same on every device.
